t: This is St Columba's Church, on Pont Street in Knightsbridge, near Harrods. It is one of the two London congregations of the Church of Scotland. The building was designed by Sir Edward Maufe, and it has been Grade II listed since 1988. Maufe built private homes and commercial and institutional buildings, but he's remembered chiefly for places of worship and memorials. His best known works are Guildford Cathedral and the Air Forces Memorial. He received the Royal Gold Medal for architecture in 1944.
